ranked_facts.why: The presence of upper abdominal distention with tympany is more consistent with a mechanical obstruction, such as that seen in intestinal obstruction (B1), rather than a motility disorder like gastrointestinal motility disorder (B2), as the latter would not typically cause such distinct physical examination findings of obstruction.

ranked_facts.concept_key: history of constipation with no bowel movement for the past 72 hours
ranked_facts.why: A history of constipation with no bowel movement for the past 72 hours could be indicative of either an obstruction (B1) or a motility issue (B2), but it contrasts with an inflammatory or infectious process (B3), which would more likely present with diarrhea or bloody stools rather than constipation.
